PRE31-C re-derived under Brandon 2026-10-02 PRE31-C ruling (a): the oracle records the strict, freestanding truth, where a C library call is an unknown call and strict counts an unknown call as a side effect, so an argument whose only effect is such a call is strict TP; the hosted contract that calls it pure is the relaxation, tagged contract:stdlib_call_effects (ADR-0014, ADR-0015 D5); see pre31-ruling-2026-a01's manifest notes
